            StoreKey,
            toMonth(DateKey) AS month,
            sum(SalesAmount) AS sales
        FROM retail.FactSales
        WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01') AND DateKey < toDate('2010-01-01')
        GROUP BY StoreKey, month
    ),
    annual_target AS (
        SELECT
            StoreKey,
            sum(SalesAmountQuota) / 12 AS monthly_target
        FROM retail.FactSalesQuota
        WHERE ScenarioKey = 2
          AND DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01') AND DateKey < toDate('2010-01-01')
        GROUP BY StoreKey
    ),
    skeleton AS (
        SELECT
            st.StoreKey AS StoreKey,
            st.StoreName AS StoreName,
            m.month AS month,
            coalesce(ms.sales, 0) AS sales,
            coalesce(at.monthly_target, 0) AS monthly_target
        FROM retail.DimStore AS st
        CROSS JOIN (SELECT number + 1 AS month FROM numbers(12)) AS m
        LEFT JOIN annual_target AS at ON st.StoreKey = at.StoreKey
        LEFT JOIN monthly_sales AS ms ON st.StoreKey = ms.StoreKey AND m.month = ms.month
    ),
    flags AS (
        SELECT
            StoreKey,
            StoreName,
            month,
            monthly_target,
            sales,
            if(monthly_target > 0 AND sales < monthly_target, 1, 0) AS is_miss
        FROM skeleton
    ),
    grouped AS (
        SELECT
            StoreKey,
            StoreName,
            month,
            is_miss,
            month - row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY StoreKey, is_miss ORDER BY month) AS grp
        FROM flags
    ),
    segments AS (
        SELECT
            StoreKey,
            StoreName,
            min(month) AS start_month,
            max(month) AS end_month,
            count() AS consecutive_months
        FROM grouped
        WHERE is_miss = 1
        GROUP BY StoreKey, StoreName, grp
        HAVING consecutive_months >= 3
    )
SELECT
    StoreKey AS store_key,
    StoreName AS store_name,
    start_month,
    end_month,
    consecutive_months
FROM segments
ORDER BY store_key, start_month;

    ),

        SELECT

    ),

            any(annual_target) AS annual_target,

        FROM (

            maxIf(f.DateKey, f.DateKey <= toDate('2009-12-31')) AS last_date_2009
        FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f

                dateDiff('month', last_date_2009, toDate('2009-12-31')) <= 12, '有流失风险',
                '已流失'
            ) AS end_status
        FROM last_dates
    ),
    status_values AS (
        SELECT arrayJoin(['活跃', '有流失风险', '已流失']) AS status_label
    ),
    pairs AS (
        SELECT

            start_status,

FROM pairs AS p
LEFT JOIN counts AS c
    ON p.start_status = c.start_status
   AND p.end_status = c.end_status

WITH
    store_year AS (
        SELECT StoreKey, toYear(DateKey) AS yr, sum(SalesAmount) AS amt
        FROM retail.FactSales
        WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2008-01-01') AND DateKey <= toDate('2009-12-31')
        GROUP BY StoreKey, yr
    ),
    store_pivot AS (
        SELECT StoreKey,
               sumIf(amt, yr = 2008) AS amt_2008,
               sumIf(amt, yr = 2009) AS amt_2009
        FROM store_year
        GROUP BY StoreKey
        HAVING sumIf(amt, yr = 2008) > 0 AND sumIf(amt, yr = 2009) > 0
    ),
    store_decl AS (
        SELECT StoreKey,
               amt_2008,
               amt_2009,
               amt_2008 - amt_2009 AS decrease_amount,
               (amt_2008 - amt_2009) / amt_2008 * 100 AS decrease_pct,
               rank() OVER (ORDER BY (amt_2008 - amt_2009) / amt_2008 DESC) AS store_rank,
               row_number() OVER (ORDER BY (amt_2008 - amt_2009) / amt_2008 DESC, StoreKey) AS store_rn
        FROM store_pivot
        WHERE amt_2009 < amt_2008
    ),
    top3 AS (
        SELECT d.StoreKey AS StoreKey,
               st.StoreName AS StoreName,
               d.decrease_amount AS store_decrease_amount,
               d.decrease_pct AS store_decrease_pct,
               d.store_rank AS store_rank
        FROM store_decl AS d
        INNER JOIN retail.DimStore AS st ON d.StoreKey = st.StoreKey
        WHERE d.store_rn <= 3
    ),
    cat_year AS (
        SELECT f.StoreKey AS StoreKey,
               toYear(f.DateKey) AS yr,
               c.ProductCategoryKey AS category_key,
               c.ProductCategoryName AS category_name,
               sum(f.SalesAmount) AS amt
        FROM retail.FactSales AS f
        LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
        LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS s ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = s.ProductSubcategoryKey
        LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS c ON s.ProductCategoryKey = c.ProductCategoryKey
        WHERE f.DateKey >= toDate('2008-01-01') AND f.DateKey <= toDate('2009-12-31')
        GROUP BY f.StoreKey, yr, c.ProductCategoryKey, c.ProductCategoryName
    ),
    cat_pivot AS (
        SELECT StoreKey,
               category_key,
               category_name,
               sumIf(amt, yr = 2008) AS cat_2008,
               sumIf(amt, yr = 2009) AS cat_2009
        FROM cat_year
        GROUP BY StoreKey, category_key, category_name
    ),
    cat_decl AS (
        SELECT t.StoreKey AS StoreKey,
               t.StoreName AS StoreName,
               t.store_decrease_pct AS store_decrease_pct,
               t.store_decrease_amount AS store_decrease_amount,
               t.store_rank AS store_rank,
               cp.category_key AS category_key,
               cp.category_name AS category_name,
               cp.cat_2008 AS category_sales_2008,
               cp.cat_2009 AS category_sales_2009,
               cp.cat_2008 - cp.cat_2009 AS category_decrease_amount,
               (cp.cat_2008 - cp.cat_2009) / nullIf(cp.cat_2008, 0) * 100 AS category_decrease_pct,
               (cp.cat_2008 - cp.cat_2009) / nullIf(t.store_decrease_amount, 0) * 100 AS category_share_pct,
               rank() OVER (PARTITION BY t.StoreKey ORDER BY (cp.cat_2008 - cp.cat_2009) DESC) AS category_rank,
               row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.StoreKey ORDER BY (cp.cat_2008 - cp.cat_2009) DESC, ifNull(cp.category_key, -1)) AS category_rn
        FROM top3 AS t
        INNER JOIN cat_pivot AS cp ON t.StoreKey = cp.StoreKey
    )
SELECT
    StoreKey,
    StoreName,
    store_decrease_pct,
    store_decrease_amount,
    category_key,
    category_name,
    category_sales_2008,
    category_sales_2009,
    category_decrease_amount,
    category_decrease_pct,
    category_share_pct,
    store_rank,

        FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
        INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
        WHERE f.DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01') AND f.DateKey < toDate('2010-01-01')

        FROM order_product

        FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
        WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01') AND DateKey < toDate('2010-01-01')

        INNER JOIN order_product AS b

        GROUP BY key1, key2
    ),
    ranked AS (
        SELECT
            key1,
            key2,
            common_orders,
            rank() OVER (ORDER BY common_orders DESC)                    AS pair_rank,
            row_number() OVER (ORDER BY common_orders DESC, key1, key2)  AS rn
        FROM pairs
    )
SELECT
    r.key1                                                           AS product1_key,
    p1.ProductName                                                   AS product1_name,
    r.key2                                                           AS product2_key,
    p2.ProductName                                                   AS product2_name,
    r.common_orders                                                  AS common_orders,
    r.common_orders * t.n_total_orders / (o1.n_orders * o2.n_orders)  AS lift_ratio,
    r.pair_rank                                                      AS pair_rank
FROM ranked AS r
INNER JOIN product_orders AS o1 ON r.key1 = o1.product_key
INNER JOIN product_orders AS o2 ON r.key2 = o2.product_key
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p1 ON r.key1 = p1.ProductKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p2 ON r.key2 = p2.ProductKey
CROSS JOIN total AS t
WHERE r.rn <= 10
ORDER BY r.rn

WITH
store_totals AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        sumIf(SalesAmount, toYear(DateKey) = 2008) AS sales_2008,
        sumIf(SalesAmount, toYear(DateKey) = 2009) AS sales_2009,
        countIf(toYear(DateKey) = 2008) AS rows_2008,
        countIf(toYear(DateKey) = 2009) AS rows_2009
    FROM retail.FactSales
    WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2008-01-01') AND DateKey < toDate('2010-01-01')
    GROUP BY StoreKey
    HAVING rows_2008 > 0 AND rows_2009 > 0
),
store_declines AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        sales_2008,
        sales_2009,
        sales_2008 - sales_2009 AS store_decline_amount,
        (sales_2008 - sales_2009) / nullIf(sales_2008, 0) * 100 AS store_decline_pct
    FROM store_totals
    WHERE sales_2009 < sales_2008
),
store_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        sales_2008,
        sales_2009,
        store_decline_amount,
        store_decline_pct,
        rank() OVER (ORDER BY store_decline_pct DESC) AS store_rank,
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY store_decline_pct DESC, StoreKey ASC) AS rn
    FROM store_declines
),
top3 AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        store_decline_amount,
        store_decline_pct,
        store_rank
    FROM store_ranked
    WHERE rn <= 3
),
category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        f.StoreKey AS StoreKey,
        c.ProductCategoryKey AS category_key,
        c.ProductCategoryName AS category_name,
        sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toYear(f.DateKey) = 2008) AS sales_2008,
        sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009) AS sales_2009
    FROM retail.FactSales AS f
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS s
        ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = s.ProductSubcategoryKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS c
        ON s.ProductCategoryKey = c.ProductCategoryKey
    WHERE f.DateKey >= toDate('2008-01-01') AND f.DateKey < toDate('2010-01-01')
      AND f.StoreKey IN (SELECT StoreKey FROM top3)
    GROUP BY f.StoreKey, c.ProductCategoryKey, c.ProductCategoryName
),
category_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        category_key,
        category_name,
        sales_2008,
        sales_2009,
        sales_2008 - sales_2009 AS category_decline_amount,
        (sales_2008 - sales_2009) / nullIf(sales_2008, 0) * 100 AS category_decline_pct,
        rank() OVER (
            PARTITION BY StoreKey
            ORDER BY (sales_2008 - sales_2009) DESC
        ) AS category_rank,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY StoreKey
            ORDER BY (sales_2008 - sales_2009) DESC, ifNull(category_key, -1) ASC
        ) AS category_rn
    FROM category_sales
)
SELECT
    t.StoreKey AS store_key,
    st.StoreName AS store_name,
    t.store_decline_pct AS store_decline_pct,
    t.store_decline_amount AS store_decline_amount,
    cr.category_key AS category_key,
    cr.category_name AS category_name,
    cr.category_decline_amount AS category_decline_amount,
    cr.category_decline_pct AS category_decline_pct,
    cr.category_decline_amount / nullIf(t.store_decline_amount, 0) * 100 AS category_share_pct,
    t.store_rank AS store_rank,
    cr.category_rank AS category_rank
FROM top3 AS t
INNER JOIN category_ranked AS cr
    ON t.StoreKey = cr.StoreKey AND cr.category_rn = 1
INNER JOIN retail.DimStore AS st
    ON t.StoreKey = st.StoreKey
ORDER BY t.store_rank ASC, t.StoreKey ASC
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1

WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT
        c.ProductCategoryName AS product_category_name,
        toMonth(f.DateKey) AS month_number,
        sum(f.SalesAmount) AS monthly_sales
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p

stats AS (
    SELECT
        product_category_name,
        sum(monthly_sales) AS total_sales,
        sum(monthly_sales * monthly_sales) AS total_sales_squared

)
SELECT

    total_sales / 12 AS avg_monthly_sales,
    sqrt(
        greatest(
            total_sales_squared / 12 - (total_sales / 12) * (total_sales / 12),

    ) / nullIf(total_sales / 12, 0) AS cv
FROM stats
ORDER BY cv DESC, product_category_name

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        d.CalendarYear              AS year,
        c.ProductCategoryName       AS category_name,
        sum(f.SalesAmount)          AS sales_amount,
        sum(f.TotalCost)            AS total_cost
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d
        ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
        ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS s
        ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = s.ProductSubcategoryKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS c
        ON s.ProductCategoryKey = c.ProductCategoryKey
    WHERE d.CalendarYear BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009
    GROUP BY year, category_name
),
calc AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        category_name,
        sales_amount,
        total_cost,
        sales_amount - total_cost                                                  AS gross_profit,
        (sales_amount - total_cost) / nullIf(sales_amount, 0) * 100                AS gross_margin_pct
    FROM base
)
SELECT
    year,
    category_name,
    sales_amount,
    total_cost,
    gross_profit,
    gross_margin_pct,
    gross_margin_pct - lagInFrame(gross_margin_pct) OVER (
        PARTITION BY category_name
        ORDER BY year
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
    ) AS gross_margin_change_pp
FROM calc
ORDER BY category_name, year

WITH
    store_rev AS (
        SELECT f.EntityKey AS EntityKey, sum(f.Amount) AS revenue
        FROM retail.FactStrategyPlan AS f
        INNER JOIN retail.DimScenario AS s ON f.ScenarioKey = s.ScenarioKey
        INNER JOIN retail.DimAccount AS a ON f.AccountKey = a.AccountKey
        WHERE s.ScenarioName = 'Actual'
          AND a.AccountName = 'Sale Revenue'
        GROUP BY f.EntityKey
    ),
    chain AS (
        SELECT
            e0.EntityKey AS StoreEntityKey,
            arrayDistinct([e0.EntityKey, e1.EntityKey, e2.EntityKey, e3.EntityKey]) AS ancestors
        FROM retail.DimEntity AS e0
        INNER JOIN retail.DimEntity AS e1 ON toInt32(e0.ParentEntityKey) = e1.EntityKey
        INNER JOIN retail.DimEntity AS e2 ON toInt32(e1.ParentEntityKey) = e2.EntityKey
        INNER JOIN retail.DimEntity AS e3 ON toInt32(e2.ParentEntityKey) = e3.EntityKey
        WHERE e0.EntityType = 'Store'
    ),
    store_ancestor AS (
        SELECT StoreEntityKey, ancestor_key
        FROM chain
        ARRAY JOIN ancestors AS ancestor_key
    )
SELECT
    e.EntityKey        AS EntityKey,
    e.EntityName       AS EntityName,
    e.EntityType       AS EntityType,
    sum(r.revenue)     AS total_amount
FROM store_ancestor AS sa
INNER JOIN store_rev AS r ON sa.StoreEntityKey = r.EntityKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimEntity AS e ON sa.ancestor_key = e.EntityKey
GROUP BY EntityKey, EntityName, EntityType
ORDER BY EntityKey
turns.assumption: 口径为战略计划 Actual 场景、Sale Revenue 科目；组织层级沿 DimEntity 父链对每级祖先各计一次（祖先键去重，虚拟门店不走州级），因此各层级合计不相等、不能相加。
